          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 問題サマリー",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex MCP Server のビルド時に以下のエラーが発生：",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "error: could not compile &#96;bstr&#96; (lib)",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "STATUS_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION (0xc000001d)",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔍 根本原因分析",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 問題の特定",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "| 項目 | 期待値 | 実際の値 | 問題 |",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|--------|---------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Rustバージョン** | 1.90.0 (rust-toolchain.toml) | 1.92.0-nightly | ❌ 不一致 |",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "| **ツールチェーン** | stable | nightly | ❌ 不一致 |",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "| **CPUターゲット** | 汎用 | 最適化（AVX2等） | ❌ 命令セット不一致 |",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラーの原因",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **ツールチェーンの不一致**",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;rust-toolchain.toml&#96; で 1.90.0 を指定",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 実際には nightly (1.92.0) が使用されていた",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "   - nightly の最適化が CPU と不一致",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **CPU命令セットの問題**",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;bstr&#96; クレートが AVX/AVX2 命令を使用",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "   - CPUまたはエミュレーション環境が対応していない",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;STATUS_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION&#96; エラー発生",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 修正手順",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー修正{main}.md",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## コンパイルエラー修正作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "検出されたコンパイルエラーの修正を実施",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 実施内容",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 初期修正（fix_compilation_errors.py）",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 修正対象エラー",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- ❌ 型ミスマッチ: Option&lt;Value&gt; vs Value",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- ❌ 構造体フィールド欠如: annotations, output_schema",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- ❌ API互換性: mcp_types::ServerCapabilities Default未実装",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 修正内容",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **main.rs**: 冗長な &#96;use tracing_subscriber;&#96; を削除",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **bridge.rs**:",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;request.params&#96; の Option&lt;Value&gt; を適切に処理（&#96;.ok_or_else()&#96;）",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;ServerCapabilities&#96; の &#96;Default::default()&#96; を手動構築に変更",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;JSONRPCResponse&#96; の構造修正（errorフィールド削除）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **tools.rs**: Tool構造体に必須フィールド追加（annotations, output_schema, title）",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 修正結果",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ スクリプト実行成功",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ 3つの主要エラー修正完了",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 新規検出エラー分析",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "コンパイルチェックで新たに15個のエラーが検出：",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "#### tokio関連エラー（9個）",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved imports &#96;tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::BufReader&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- **原因**: tokioの&#96;io-util&#96; featureが有効化されていない",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;features = [\"io-util\"]&#96; を追加",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved import &#96;tokio::sync::mpsc&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved import &#96;tokio::sync::Mutex&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- **原因**: tokioの&#96;sync&#96; featureが有効化されていない",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- **解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;features = [\"sync\"]&#96; を追加",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "#### ToolInputSchema型ミスマッチ（3個）",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0308]: expected &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96;, found &#96;Value&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "- **原因**: &#96;json!()&#96; マクロの戻り値が &#96;Value&#96; だが &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96; が期待されている",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "- **解決**: 適切な型変換または &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96; の直接構築",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "#### その他のエラー",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "- stdoutのメソッド未解決（write_all, flush）",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- ライフタイム関連のSized制約エラー",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Cargo.toml修正",
            "lineNumber": 54
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3906281888484955
    },

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "### 1. 初期修正（fix_compilation_errors.py）",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 新規検出エラー分析",

          },
          {
            "text": "コンパイルチェックで新たに15個のエラーが検出：",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "#### tokio関連エラー（9個）",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved imports &#96;tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::BufReader&#96;",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32

          {
            "text": "- **原因**: tokioの&#96;io-util&#96; featureが有効化されていない",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;features = [\"io-util\"]&#96; を追加",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved import &#96;tokio::sync::mpsc&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved import &#96;tokio::sync::Mutex&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- **原因**: tokioの&#96;sync&#96; featureが有効化されていない",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- **解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;features = [\"sync\"]&#96; を追加",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "#### ToolInputSchema型ミスマッチ（3個）",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0308]: expected &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96;, found &#96;Value&#96;",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },

          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 89

          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;ModelClient::new&#96;は&#96;ModelInfo&#96;を要求するが、&#96;ModelFamily&#96;を渡している",

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ModelFamily&#96;から&#96;ModelInfo&#96;への変換関数を作成または使用",

          {
            "text": "**修正例**:",

            "text": "//! Metal GPU execution tool for MCP",

            "lineNumber": 2
          },

            "text": "use anyhow::Result;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },

            "text": "/// Execute Metal operation",

            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "pub async fn execute_metal(request: MetalExecuteRequest) -&gt; Result&lt;MetalExecuteResult&gt; {",

          },

          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "    info!(\"Executing Metal operation: {:?}\", request.operation);",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    let runtime = MetalRuntime::new()?;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    let chip_info = runtime.get_chip_info()?;",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    // TODO: Implement actual Metal operations",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    // For now, return placeholder",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    Ok(MetalExecuteResult {",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "        success: true,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "        output: format!(",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"Metal operation completed on {}\",",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "            chip_info.chip_type.label()",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "        ),",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "        execution_time_ms: 0,",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    })",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Metal execution request",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },

            "text": "#[derive(Debug, serde::Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
